body: Gold -28% in 2013 is USD; ~-16% in INR, and INR gold stayed below its 2012 peak until mid-2019 (~80 months) while Nifty ~6,100->11,000 (Dec-13 to Dec-17): the video's own gold example is contradicted. 2017 international-fund and 2022 RBI-hike facts check out. No definition of 'underperforming', no backtest, hindsight examples; fights 3-12m momentum. Keep: fixed split + rebalancing, direct new money (tax-efficient), governance caution. Test as a variant in the planned allocation study.
title: Category-rotation 'buy the laggard' MF strategy: keep mechanical rebalancing + new-money-to-underweight; reject discretionary cycle timing
